text:
Evan J: kicking off pilot onramp with NimbleRetail. want to align success criteria + ask for missing contacts
Sanjay K: sounds good. quick agenda? :calendar:
Evan J: 1) stakeholders 2) success metrics 3) infra / network 4) eval prompts 5) timelines / pricing
Liz - Solutions: add security questionnaire owner and SSO/SCIM touchpoints
Claire (NimbleRetail): I'm joining from Product, can invite our infra lead (Rahul). We're fine w/ 2-week pilot.
Maria P: noted. two-week baseline ok. acceptance = 95th p90 latency < 250ms and avg token cost under $0.002
Evan J: do we need private deployment or can hosted work? any PCI/PHI data?
Claire (NimbleRetail): no PHI. some order data is sensitive — prefer VPC peering if possible
Sanjay K: ok — we can propose Dedicated or Private. I'll ask eng-infra about VPC peering/whitelisting windows
Liz - Solutions: action: send pre-POC security questionnaire. Claire, can your legal sign our DPA template within 5 days?
Claire (NimbleRetail): legal looped in. may need minor edits. we can aim for 7 days.
Evan J: for evals — can you share 10 representative prompts and a gold-standard output set? we'll run regression and quality checks
Claire (NimbleRetail): yes. I'll drop prompts and examples in a shared drive by EOD tomorrow. tag @Liz
Liz - Solutions: thanks. will run small eval harness. prefer prompts in csv with id,prompt,expected
Maria P: on telemetry — we need sample traffic profile (queries/min, typical seq length, burst patterns) to set batchers
Claire (NimbleRetail): avg 8 q/min in normal, spikes to 120 q/min during campaigns. avg seq 120 tokens
Sanjay K: noted. that influences instance sizing and pricing
Evan J: pricing question from account exec: do you want fixed committed capacity or usage billing? we can provide a 2-week trial credit + conversion discount
Claire (NimbleRetail): prefer trial credit, then evaluate. need an estimate for 2-week trial cost with the traffic mix
Maria P: I'll model cost tonight and share a ballpark. also note model variants: we'll run a smaller quantized model for latency tests, then full model for quality
Liz - Solutions: on SSO — do you have Okta? SCIM provisioning?
Claire (NimbleRetail): Okta yes, SCIM later. just SAML SSO for now
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: demo-env provisioned for nimble-retail-pilot at 2027-05-12T14:00Z
Evan J: next steps: 1) Claire to share prompts + traffic matrix by tomorrow 2) Legal to review DPA 3) Maria to share cost estimate today 4) Sanjay to confirm VPC peering feasibility 5) Liz to send security questionnaire
Claire (NimbleRetail): 👍 I'll get those items in motion
Liz - Solutions: I'll schedule a 30-min kickoff call for Wed 10am PT — invite to follow
Sanjay K: if infra lead Rahul can make it that'd be great
Evan J: thanks all. tagging followups: @Maria P @Liz - Solutions @Sanjay K
